text:
maya: Short design sync: routing editor feedback from user testing. Key issues: label 'Stack' confusing, keyboard reorder loses focus, validation messages unclear, preview doesn't show matched rule. Posting brief notes so we can triage.

thomas: Agree on renaming to 'Priority'. Also the drag handle needs a larger hit area and higher contrast.

lia: Accessibility: when reordering via keyboard focus is lost. We should keep focus on moved item and announce new position with aria-live. Example announcement: 'Rule — moved to position 2'.

oliver: Copy fix: change 'No conflicts' -> 'No conflicting rules detected'. For errors show who conflicts with whom: 'Priority conflict: rule A and rule B share priority 5.' Add a tiny 'How to fix' link.

sam: Preview sim: add a compact trace toggle that expands to show evaluation steps and highlights the matched rule. Collapsed state shows 'Matched: rule 3'.

designbot: Uploaded small proto and contrast check. Current handle color fails AA at small sizes. Suggest darker handle and 24px touch target.

maya: Action items: (1) rename 'Stack' -> 'Priority' (thomas), (2) improve handle contrast + hit area (thomas/designbot), (3) implement aria-live & focus retention on reorder (lia), (4) richer validation copy + fix links (oliver), (5) preview trace compact toggle (sam). I'll open an epic and assign.

thomas: I'll start on rename + handle today.

lia: I'll prototype the live announcement and keyboard tests tomorrow.

oliver: Drafting copy variants now.

sam: I'll mock the trace UI by EOD.
